remarks: Check out this newly renovated 1-bedroom apartment located in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Enjoy the best of in-town living with shops, restaurants, parks, and the train station just steps away, making this an ideal location for commuters.  The unit features modern updates throughout and offers a bright, comfortable space to call home. Pets are welcome at the owner's discretion (no aggressive breeds), with a $45 monthly pet fee.  Applicants must have a minimum credit score of 650. First month's rent and one month's security deposit are required. Household gross monthly income must be at least three times the rental amount. Tenants are responsible for gas and electric utilities.
